candidates.name: Technical guidance for GML files
verified_facts: HM Land Registry data is captured against the British National Grid.
INSPIRE polygon geometry can be reprojected from EPSG:27700 for web mapping.
HMLR warns that projection conversion to WGS84 may shift some features by up to 15 metres.
semantic_limits: Reprojected web-display geometry is not accepted as the exact metric geometry for point-in-polygon or parcel height calculations; EPSG:27700 source geometry remains canonical.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model DSM 1m
verified_facts: The 1m DSM covers about 99% of England.
The DSM includes heights of objects such as vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as the terrain surface.
The 2022 composite uses Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys and uses newest best-resolution data where repeats exist.
semantic_limits: DSM is not bare-earth terrain and must not silently replace DTM in parcel ground-height difference calculations.
